look: Dark futuristic intelligence system: classified cyber intelligence, futuristic tactical cartography, advanced computer systems and cinematic sci-fi interface design. An enormous encrypted digital city observed through a secret high-tech surveillance terminal; architecturally precise, restrained, extraordinarily detailed. Cyan = the signal, muted blue = the city, amber = suspicion, red = the breach. ONE continuous camera shot until the final hard cut to black.

scenes.name: The heist
scenes.desc: One unbroken camera move: the city assembles, the cyan signal slips past scanners, escapes a trap, outruns the alarm, threads the vault rings and turns the whole network red.

scenes.name: Breached
scenes.desc: Hard cut to black; BREACHED. rises in cold white with a red edge.
